name: SurgT Challenge
description: Benchmarks soft-tissue tracking algorithms for robotic surgery by evaluating tracker accuracy and robustness on annotated surgical video sequences.
evaluation_method: Intersection-over-Union (IoU) / Dice for segmentation and overlap-based tracking metrics, average center error and success/robustness rate for tracking
general_score_metric: Dice / IoU (for segmentation) and success/robustness rate (for tracking)
reputation: A reputable, peer-reviewed surgical-vision benchmark used by researchers working on soft-tissue tracking and surgical robotics; respected within that niche community.
notes: Domain-specific surgical videos with deformation and occlusion make tasks challenging; relatively small and specialized dataset, annotation variability and patient-privacy considerations; non-LLM benchmark.
